Remark
[Structure constants]

Source: petersen:page-0129 ↗ def:pet-ch3-curvature-tensor

1. ch3:3.4.27For an orthonormal frame $E_1,\dots ,E_n$ define structure constants $c^k_{ij}$ by $[E_i,E_j]=c^k_{ij}E_k$ (functions on $M$), and $\Gamma ^k_{ij},R^l_{ijk}$ by $\nabla _{E_i}E_j=\Gamma ^k_{ij}E_k$, $R(E_i,E_j)E_k=R^l_{ijk}E_l$. Compute $\Gamma ,R$ in terms of the $c^k_{ij}$; note that on a Lie group with a left-invariant metric the $c^k_{ij}$ may be taken constant.
